source: Open Images test split (2018_04 image metadata/v5 human bbox annotations)
order: ascending OpenImages ImageID per class, no model outputs; first eligible unique author/session
eligibility: physical raw target; full image uncropped; exactly one selected produce category annotated; target box area>=0.25 image; IsDepiction=0 IsInside=0; min side>=200; no prepared food/preserved/mixed ambiguous category/subtype ambiguity; on-plant raw photos allowed but flagged context
exclusions: all prior 16 selected images + all 116 development-validation candidate IDs/raw hashes/decoded pixels; exclude prior selected authors; distinct Flickr author within new cohort
dedup: SHA256 source+decoded RGB; perceptual dHash Hamming<=6 rejected for near-duplicate; original Flickr landing URL grouping
inference: no model runs; names only registry inspection; opaque PNG full RGB plus blinded id/path/sha256 CSV
stopping: fixed deadline; retain every eligible source encountered in deterministic sequence until per-class target; shortfall reported, never fill using prediction scores
